insight.description: Compares the platforms’ pricing models and explains how their billing units and cost drivers affect relative cost for different usage patterns.
Synthesizes differences in core vector-search capabilities and related features, explaining what users gain or give up across platforms.
Connects deployment options and scaling or operational characteristics to their practical trade-offs for platform selection.
Draws clear, differentiated conclusions about which platforms best fit particular needs, based on the pricing and feature comparisons.

readability.description: Presents pricing and features in a consistent structure across platforms so readers can compare them directly.
Explains pricing units and technical terms needed to understand the comparison without assuming specialist knowledge.
Moves from an overview of the platforms through pricing and feature comparisons to a clear, easy-to-find takeaway.
